sources.title: Chartreuse/README.md at main · OrbFrontend/Chartreuse · GitHub
sources.snippet: Classifier — sentence-level binary classifier gating purple prose (and euphemism) at 1 / 0. Input is always one sentence; callers segment upstream and score each sentence independently. Favors precision — a false positive rewrites good prose. The hard part is the dataset, not the model. Depurple — weight-baked style edit for open LLMs: find the residual direction separating purple/plain ...
